checks.name: Required job fields expose native required semantics
Landing exposes the builder on narrow screens
Required-field errors focus the summary, link to inputs and preserve values
Worked example is editable and generates a complete scoped handoff
Replacing answers requires confirmation; cancel and accept both preserve edited output
Answers are literal text; hostile markup does not create elements or run
Changing answers marks the preview stale without losing manual edits
Copy reads the actual editable output into the browser clipboard
A real denied clipboard selects the text and explains manual recovery
Markdown download contains the current edits and UTF-8 text exactly
Empty edited output cannot be copied or downloaded as a claimed success
Keyboard navigation and focus remain visible
Responsive composition and practical form controls at 1440px
Responsive composition and practical form controls at 1024px
Responsive composition and practical form controls at 768px
Responsive composition and practical form controls at 390px
Responsive composition and practical form controls at 320px
No answers enter browser storage and no external requests occur during the flow

limitations: Chromium emulation; no physical device or screen-reader session.
No model or comparative design-quality benchmark.
